2. Reason: The WebSurfer clicked on a link that resulted in a 404 error, meaning the specific URL (`https://www.olympedia.org/counts/edition`) does not exist or has moved. This action failed to retrieve the necessary data (athlete counts per country). Instead of retrying with a corrected URL or clicking a different visible link from the search results, the agent should have navigated to a working page, such as the main Olympedia page for the 1928 Games or the Wikipedia page which often contains the participation table further down. This error halts progress toward finding the answer.
